name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Blacksmith goes with Highrow or Boots goes with Matilda.

Boots goes with exactly three of Wulfric, Potter, Kingsford, and Duke.
Between Duke and Prince, one goes with Blacksmith and the other with Potter.
If Millpond does not go with Potter, then Highrow goes with Rope.
